title: Nui Than Tai Hot Spring Park

html:
Nui Than Tai Hot Spring Park, hidden in the nature reserve of Ba Na Nui Chua scenic area, where there is mountainous terrain with underground mineral springs and natural hot water sources.

Nui Than Tai is a tourist destination sought by many tourists, especially an attractive resort suitable for all ages, most tourists traveling to Da Nang visit Nui Than Tai Hot Spring Park.

After having enjoyed visiting the scenic spots of Da Nang, tourists often choose a peaceful resort, to have private time, and experience relaxation by soaking in natural mineral water, Nui Than Tai is a destination exclusively for tourists.

Coming to the Nui Than Tai scenic area, visitors will be able to participate in many interesting games, especially soaking in the mineral springs to dispel the hustle and bustle of everyday life. For children, participating in games at the water park with many games will make them excited.

Surrounding the Nui Than Tai scenic area are rows of cool green trees, with natural spring water, visitors can experience mud baths, soak in therapeutic methods, helping you have the most relaxing moments.

In addition, you can also bathe in onsen in Japanese style, which is currently one of the unique experiences in Vietnam. Experiencing the Nui Than Tai climbing tour at the end of the Da Nang tour is the best choice for you to relax before returning to the city.

If you are a person who loves to explore new things and participate in games, Nui Than Tai Park is the destination for you with games such as: wave pool on the mountainside, spiral slide, Long Tien Cave…

In addition, in the Nui Than Tai scenic area, there are also high-class restaurants, luxury resorts where you can stay overnight to relax and enjoy the interesting things that this place brings to visitors, especially watching free 9D to 12D movies.

Nui Than Tai scenic area is built in a cool green campus, giving visitors the most comfortable vacation, especially visitors on a one-day tour Ba Na, Nui Than Tai scenic area is an indispensable choice.

The resort is both luxurious, peaceful, and has a diverse entertainment area, airy space, especially the Than Tai hot spring park also has many interesting water games.

At the Than Tai Mountain Hot Spring Resort, there is also a spiritual tourist destination, the Than Tai Temple, where visitors often come to pray for luck, health and peace.

It can be said that Nui Than Hot Spring Park is the most ideal resort in Da Nang. When you have enjoyed exploring all the famous sights in Da Nang, Nui Than Hot Spring Park is the final resort in the journey of visitors, bringing them experiences and moments of relaxation before returning to their daily work.

Highlights when visiting Than Tai Mountain

  • Nhan Tai Hot Spring Resort is a destination for tourists who love to admire the beauty of nature and discover new things.
  • Soaking in the hot water from nature, and participating in those underwater activities will be one of the unique experiences at Than Tai Mountain scenic area.Bathing in natural mineral mud, bathing in Onsen Tower in Japanese style.
  • Watching 9D to 12D movies for free, and enjoying delicious cuisine at the restaurant, experiencing a luxurious resort… and many more interesting things are waiting for visitors to discover.
